channel_numbering: one-based DI1..DI6; PT-bank assignment is independent of fuel-rail assignment
release_condition: Current path remains reserved through demagnetization and a qualified guard interval; START falling alone does not release it
boost_concurrency_basis: Conservative admission policy until shared-converter peak/recharge/thermal capability is qualified; not an experimentally determined maximum
other_overlap_limitations: Separate current paths permit independent control structurally; they do not establish shared supply or thermal capacity
HPFP current paths are distinct but HPFP/DI simultaneous power and microcode execution still require qualification
A fully serialized schedule may reject a requested injection; never silently move it outside the approved injection window
No exact B58B30 Gen2 boost duration, inductance, demagnetization timing or OEM current calibration is inferred from family data
